name: COMBS (open-source multi-physics HPC benchmark suite)
description: An open-source benchmark suite of multi-physics simulation kernels and problem sets designed to evaluate performance and behavior of HPC systems and codes.
general_score_metric: time_to_solution / throughput (runtime, e.g., seconds, GFLOPS, jobs/sec)
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on HPC; results are highly hardware-, compiler- and library-dependent, sensitive to problem size and tuning; reproducibility can be challenging across systems.
